summary: Backend-only verification of the 'duplicate KP / stale calculator order per amocrm_id' fix. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_kp_duplicate_latest_iteration126.py (9 tests, 8 passed). Verified GET /api/sauna-crm/leads/LEAD-KPDUP/calculator-order returns the LATEST order (ORD-NEW / 'NEW KP' / .../new.pdf) via the amocrm_id fallback after clearing the stored link, that the latest link is persisted back to the lead, and that the internal link_calculator_order() helper attaches the KP document built from the newest calculator_pdfs record (.../new.pdf). Regression with a single-order lead (TEST_LEAD_SINGLE_126) passes, and unknown lead returns 404. Code review confirmed sort=[('createdAt',-1)] present at all 5 reported amocrm.py locations (1226, 1734, 3394, 3500, 3585) and in sauna_crm.py (672 area, 1693). However, the SAME bug class is still unfixed in routes/widget.py, which serves the widget embedded in the amoCRM deal card: /api/widget/orders-status/KPDUP_TEST_1 returns ORD-OLD ('OLD KP') instead of ORD-NEW.

critical.issue: find_one({'amocrm_id': ...}) without sort -> returns the OLDEST/arbitrary order. Reproduced live: returned ORD-OLD ('OLD KP') while ORD-NEW exists. This widget is embedded in the amoCRM deal card and is used by /api/widget/orders-status, /api/widget/embed/{lead_id}, /api/widget/preview/{lead_id} and salesbot-handler, so stale/duplicate KP is still user-visible despite the sauna_crm/amocrm fixes. Fix: add sort=[('createdAt', -1)] in both helpers.

minor.issue: await db[coll].find_one({'amocrm_id': lead['amocrm_id']}) without sort -> may pick stale order for production/Telegram notification.
collection.find_one({'amocrm_id': order_id}) without sort -> stale order risk.
find_one({'amocrm_id': ...}) without sort -> driver may see/update the stale duplicate order.
No sort=[('created_at',-1)]; if a KP PDF is regenerated for the same order_id, the contract can embed an outdated KP. Lower risk than the amocrm_id case but same defect class.
Diagnostic checks still use unsorted find_one by amocrm_id, so debug output can contradict the actual (now sorted) behaviour and mislead future debugging.

action_items: Add sort=[('createdAt', -1)] to get_order_by_amocrm_id and get_orders_dict_by_amocrm_id in /app/backend/routes/widget.py (confirmed still returning ORD-OLD).
Apply the same sort to telegram_production.py:95, warehouse.py:257 and driver_panel.py:463/606/735/850.
Add sort=[('created_at', -1)] to calculator_pdfs lookups in contract_template.py (778, 1200, 1226).

Consider a single shared helper (e.g. find_latest_order_by_amocrm_id) so this sorting rule cannot be forgotten again, plus a unique/compound index on (amocrm_id, createdAt) and root-cause prevention of duplicate order creation per amocrm_id.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix was applied per-callsite; 8+ other production callsites still do unsorted find_one by amocrm_id, so the bug persists in the widget/driver/telegram/warehouse paths. Extract one helper instead.
The real root cause (two orders being created for the same amocrm_id) is untouched — sorting only masks the duplication; consider deduplicating on upsert.

createdAt is stored as an ISO string; sorting works for UTC ISO-8601 with identical formatting but will break if any writer stores a different format/offset or a datetime object. Normalise the field type.
seed_data_creation: Used main-agent seeded LEAD-KPDUP / KPDUP_TEST_1 (ORD-OLD, ORD-NEW + 2 calculator_pdfs). Created and cleaned up TEST_LEAD_SINGLE_126 / TEST_AMO_SINGLE_126 / TEST_ORD_SINGLE_126 for the single-order regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_kp_duplicate_latest_iteration126.py -v. The last test (test_widget_orders_status_should_return_latest) intentionally FAILS until routes/widget.py adds sort by createdAt desc. Note LEAD-KPDUP gets calculatorOrderId re-written to ORD-NEW by the endpoint; the test unsets it first to exercise the amocrm_id fallback path. Seeded KPDUP data still present in Mongo.
rca_of_the_issue: MongoDB find_one returns an arbitrary (usually natural/insertion-order first) document, so with two orders sharing one amocrm_id the older duplicate was returned and linked to the deal. The reported fix adds sort=[('createdAt',-1)] (orders) and sort=[('created_at',-1)] (calculator_pdfs) in routes/sauna_crm.py and routes/amocrm.py — verified working. The same unsorted pattern remains in routes/widget.py (reproduced: /api/widget/orders-status/KPDUP_TEST_1 -> ORD-OLD), driver_panel.py, telegram_production.py and warehouse.py.
